svg.title: Ambassador
svg.desc: Ambassador. An out-of-process proxy that handles outbound connectivity (retries, TLS, routing) for a client. Step 1, A client you can't change: Billing calls the tax API directly over plain HTTP with no timeout. The API moves: every call fails. Step 2, A proxy beside the client: An ambassador on localhost finds the API, adds mutual TLS and a token, and forwards each call to it. Step 3, Resilience and visibility: The API times out: the ambassador retries with backoff, then opens its breaker; billing never hangs. Step 4, Know the costs: The costs: one more hop and one more process, safe retries only, and one per client or shared.

g.text: Billing calls the tax API directly over plain HTTP with no timeout. The API moves: every call fails.
An ambassador on localhost finds the API, adds mutual TLS and a token, and forwards each call to it.
The API times out: the ambassador retries with backoff, then opens its breaker; billing never hangs.
The costs: one more hop and one more process, safe retries only, and one per client or shared.
· a VM, or a pod: one shared localhost
plain HTTP, straight to the API
The tax team moves it to a new address.
The fixed address now refuses every
connection, and every tax lookup fails.
HTTPS only, with a client certificate and
an access token. Billing can send neither,
and nobody can add them to its code.
No timeout: each call holds a thread until
the API answers. When the threads run
metrics and a trace span for every call; billing itself emits none
over mutual TLS, with a token
Small on localhost, but it is
always tell: the client may need
but one failure hits them all.
Simpler: a client library, when every client uses one language.
More general: a service mesh, when every service needs this.
